title: Closing remarks about Fred Weinstein
summary: Hall credits friend Fred Weinstein for introducing him to his wife; end of the proceedings.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Right. Right, it's there to -- and my present happiness is due to my best friend, Professor Fred Weinstein, who's been a professor at Yale and Southern Connecticut State College, and now he's writing a screen play. So that's what he's devoting his time to. But he was the best -- not only was he the best man. He introduced me to my wife.
So I'd like to have you meet him and his wife, Suzanne.
